AccountView.description: Tyche's account as the latest checkpoint saved it.
AccountView.title: AccountView

AlertView.description: An alert as the log recorded it: what it said, and whether Discord got it.
AlertView.title: AlertView

BacktestRequest.description: ``tyche backtest``: the configured strategies on cached history.
BacktestRequest.title: BacktestRequest

BacktestSummary.description:
One recorded backtest, from its ``run.json`` and ``metrics.json``.

Fractions are strings as ``metrics.json`` writes them (``"0.081234"`` is 8.12%).
When the record cannot be read, ``error`` says why and the rest may be empty.
BacktestSummary.title: BacktestSummary

CapitalDefaults.description: ``tyche capital``'s defaults, for the form to show.
CapitalDefaults.title: CapitalDefaults

CapitalRunRequest.description:
``tyche capital``: each strategy alone at several account sizes. An option left
empty is left out, so the command's own default applies.
CapitalRunRequest.title: CapitalRunRequest

CashCheckView.description: One currency's cash, Tyche's against the broker's (ADR-0044).
CashCheckView.title: CashCheckView

CashView.description: Cash in one currency: settled now, and still to settle.
CashView.title: CashView

CompareProfilesRequest.description:
``tyche compare-profiles``: one backtest per risk profile; none named compares
every profile in ``config/risk/``.
CompareProfilesRequest.title: CompareProfilesRequest

ConfigFileView.description: One loaded file, as parsed and hashed: what a run record stores.
ConfigFileView.title: ConfigFileView

ConfigView.description:
The workspace's configuration, as ``tyche config check`` reads it.

When it cannot be read, ``valid`` is false, ``error`` says why, and the rest is empty.
ConfigView.title: ConfigView

DataView.description: What the Data page offers: the exchanges, and what ``--all`` fetches.
DataView.title: DataView

DifferenceView.description: One disagreement between Tyche's records and the broker's. Any one halts.
DifferenceView.title: DifferenceView

FetchRequest.description: ``tyche data fetch``: the profile's whole list, or symbols on one exchange.
FetchRequest.title: FetchRequest

GuardrailsView.description: The absolute limits no profile may pass (ADR-0032), and the money caps (ADR-0034).
GuardrailsView.title: GuardrailsView

HaltView.description: A halt stored in the latest checkpoint: the drawdown kill or reconciliation.
HaltView.title: HaltView

KillRequest.description:
``tyche kill``: no new orders from the next decision on; with ``flatten``, sell
every holding there. Run with ``--yes``: the page asked first.
KillRequest.title: KillRequest

KillView.description: The kill switch, while it is engaged (ADR-0039).
KillView.title: KillView

MarketView.description: The active market profile, in short; the whole file is under ``files``.
MarketView.title: MarketView

MoneyCapView.description: The guardrails' money caps in one currency (ADR-0034).
MoneyCapView.title: MoneyCapView

OrderView.description: One order the last run left working at the broker.
OrderView.title: OrderView

PaperRunRequest.description:
``tyche paper run``: one decision cycle on the IBKR paper account (ADR-0045).

``confirmed`` must be true: the page asks first, and the contract says so.
PaperRunRequest.title: PaperRunRequest

PaperView.description:
What the Paper page shows beside the status: the last cycle's reconciliations,
and the latest alerts, newest first.
PaperView.title: PaperView

PositionView.description: One holding, at what it cost.
PositionView.title: PositionView

ProfileCheckView.description:
One risk profile in ``config/risk/``, checked as the active one, as
``tyche config check --risk-profile <name>`` does.
ProfileCheckView.title: ProfileCheckView

ReconciliationView.description: What one comparison with IBKR found: at the check, or after the decision.
ReconciliationView.title: ReconciliationView

ReportRequest.description:
``tyche report``: write a record's report again: a backtest's, a walk-forward's, a
sweep's, a capital analysis's or a profile comparison's.
ReportRequest.title: ReportRequest

ResearchView.description: What the Research page's forms offer.
ResearchView.title: ResearchView

ResumeRequest.description:
``tyche resume``: lift the kill switch and the halts. Run with ``--yes``: the page
showed what it lifts and asked first.
ResumeRequest.title: ResumeRequest

RunLine.description: One line the command printed, on its output or its error stream.
RunLine.title: RunLine

RunView.description: A command started from the page, running or finished, with all it printed.
RunView.title: RunView

SecretsView.description: Which secrets ``.env`` sets. Never their values.
SecretsView.title: SecretsView

StrategyDetailView.description: One configured strategy: its file, budget, parameters and own risk limits.
StrategyDetailView.title: StrategyDetailView

StrategyView.description: One configured strategy and its share of equity.
StrategyView.title: StrategyView

StudySummary.description:
One recorded study, from its record file.

``headline`` is one line in words: the scheme and folds, the sweep and its trials,
each strategy's minimum viable capital, or the profiles compared. When the record
cannot be read, ``error`` says why.
StudySummary.title: StudySummary

SweepView.description: A sweep in ``config/sweeps/``: the strategy it varies and every value it tries.
SweepView.title: SweepView

WalkForwardRequest.description: ``tyche walk-forward``: folds of whole calendar years, each a backtest.
WalkForwardRequest.title: WalkForwardRequest

WorkspaceConfigView.description:
Everything the Config page shows, read-only.

``valid`` and ``error`` are ``tyche config check``'s verdict under the ``default``
profile, strategies built; the rest is empty when it fails. ``profiles`` checks every
file in ``config/risk/`` as the active one, as ``--risk-profile`` would: every profile
must fit the guardrails whichever is active, and each strategy's own limits must fit
the active one.
WorkspaceConfigView.title: WorkspaceConfigView

get.description: Every recorded backtest in the workspace, newest first.
A backtest's ``report.html``, for the page to show in a sandboxed frame.

The workspace's configuration, read-only: the check, every risk profile, the
guardrails, strategies, sweeps, market profile, and each loaded file.
What ``tyche data fetch`` can fetch: the exchanges, and what ``--all`` fetches.
The last paper cycle's reconciliations, and the latest alerts from the logs.
What the Research page's forms offer: the sweeps, and the capital defaults.

post.description: Start a ``tyche`` command; refused while another is running.

get.description: The run going now, or the last one since the console started, with its output.

The workspace, its config, which secrets are set, what stops trading, and the
account as the latest checkpoint saved it.
Every recorded walk-forward, sweep, capital analysis or profile comparison.
A study's ``report.html``, for the page to show in a sandboxed frame.
